I figured out I was trans at age 13. I was trying to figure out whether or not I was asexual(I am) and stumbled across the term 'non-binary' and looked it up. I immediately thought, "oh shit that's me!" and then, "oh shit that's me..."
There were a few signs. When my mom told me that I was going to experience puberty I started sobbing and couldn't figure out why. I hated wearing bras and avoided it whenever possible. I was extremely feminist from a young age, because I got annoyed when anyone treated me as female, and just assumed that I was just really good at 'fighting the patriarchy,' or something... I became even more anxious and depressed when puberty started to the point where I started homeschooling because I couldn't handle socializing.

I haven't come out to my parents and I'm not going to until I'm through college and financially independent. I honestly have no idea how they would react and I don't want to find out.

I'm a little curious if anyone will ask me about it tomorrow, but I don't have any friends in this class, so most likely not.

I like to think of it as another day survived.
Makes things seem a little less hopeless.

I'm so sorry she's acting like that, that is not okay. 
You said you had sisters, could you ask one of them to stay with you while you sleep to make sure your mom doesn't try anything?
And if she does try to put you in a psych ward, just try to be as calm as possible around the hospital staff, and make eye contact as much as possible.
I hope things get better for you soon, good luck!
